entities.summary: Robert C. Jubelirer is a Republican political leader in Pennsylvania. He served as a member of the Pennsylvania State Senate from 1975 to 2006. He served as President pro tempore of the Pennsylvania State Senate for all but two years from 1984 to 2006, and served as the 29th lieutenant governor of Pennsylvania between 2001 and 2003. Robert Jubelirer was a legal figures from Altoona (b. 1937-02-09, Altoona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
